title: hieracium wiesbaurianum subsp. cyathis
intro: Hieracium wiesbaurianum subsp. cyathis, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a plant species belonging to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). The health benefits of Hawkweed include its potential to treat various skin conditions, such as eczema and acne, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Hawkweed are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant and antiviral activities. Bioactive constituents of Hawkweed include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
